findings.summary: The Fish script can't parse the new three-line-per-item completion format: Fish splits the output on newlines, so the loop runs once per line rather than per item, and all completions are lost.

judge.reason: Same defect: newline-separated fields get split per line by fish, breaking all completions.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: format_completion escapes newlines in value and help text, but the Fish script never unescapes them, so users see literal \n in descriptions and values containing newlines are corrupted.

judge.reason: Escaping of newlines not unescaped in fish is a different complaint, plausible but unverifiable.

findings.label: unsure

findings.summary: The `.. versionchanged:: 8.3` note in the docstring doesn't match the changelog, which lists the fix as Unreleased after 8.3.3, so it should say 8.4.

judge.reason: Docstring version note mismatch is a documentation nit, not a behavioral defect.

findings.label: false_alarm
